title: Titans viewed Carnell Tate as "a clear guy for us to take" at No. 4

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Titans viewed Carnell Tate as "a clear guy for us to take" at No. 4
sources.description: When the Titans were on the clock with the fourth overall pick in the 2026 NFL draft, the consensus in their draft room was that wide receiver Carnell Tate was the player to pick.
